title: 第5章练气四层装一层龟息诀下藏锋芒第6章再见白芷和筑基丹
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙
content_zh:
;;
时间流逝，半年时间很快过去。
废丹院小屋内，盘膝而坐的北寒风身上散发着青色的光圈。
体内极品练气丹的灵气，正被他以《长春功》的路线，一个周天一个周天运行着，然后慢慢导入下丹田。
丹田内的气海已明显和半年前完全不一样。此时的丹田气海除了比之前大了一圈外，散发的青光也更亮，更纯。
练气期四层！
这是已经可以使用神识的境界。
停下运转的《长春功》，北寒风睁开双眼，缓缓吐出一口浊气。
“药石之力，竟至于斯！”他抚摸着腰间葫芦，心潮翻涌。
自踏入道途，仅八月光景，便已臻至练气四层。他记得《长春功》杂编有记载，纵是天品灵根，若无外物辅佐，欲达此境，亦需两年苦修。
念及此，他不由得攥紧葫芦。
短短二百余日，自己从行将就木的百岁老朽，重焕生机直至今日境界，可谓全赖此宝神异。
“得须暂缓服丹修炼了，若被人察觉修为进展如此神速，绝无活路。”
活的这些年，北寒风比谁都清楚。
一个寿元所剩无几，并且气血枯竭，经脉萎缩近乎堵塞的人。在不到一年时间就修至练气第四层，是何等的可怕，恐怖。
如被发现，以修仙界这种弱肉强食的法则，他身怀重宝的秘密必将引来杀身之祸。届时莫说得道长生，便是想求一个全尸也属奢望。
“看来，非寻一门敛息秘术不可了！”
北寒风沉吟片刻，起身走到桌边，将桌上的内门弟子身份玉牌执起。
按宗门规矩，每位内门弟子，皆可凭内门弟子身份玉牌，前往藏经阁，选取两门功法。
藏经阁典籍瀚如烟海，包罗万象，其中必有他所求之法。不过自己去是决计不行。

“那该如何……”北寒风拿着弟子玉牌，眉头紧皱。
这时他目光落在桌上一布袋子上——那是杂役弟子每个月给他送份例留下的。
或许，可以借他之手。
……
几日后的清晨，院外传来熟悉的脚步声。那名每月送来份例的灰衣杂役弟子，准时出现在了废丹院。
“北师兄，这是您本月的份例。”杂役弟子给正在院内打扫落叶的北寒风递过新的布袋，脸上依旧带着那份程式化的恭敬。
北寒风接过布袋，并未如往常般直接收起，而是抬起浑浊的双眼，看着眼前的年轻弟子，沙哑开口：“师弟，如何称呼？”
杂役弟子愣了一下，似乎没想到到这位老师兄竟会主动问询，忙答道，“回北师兄，弟子姓陈，名远。”
“陈师弟，”北寒风缓缓道，枯瘦的手指摩挲着腰间的红皮葫芦，“老朽有一事，想劳烦你走一趟。”
陈远眼中闪过一丝疑惑，但还是恭敬道，“师兄请讲，若弟子力所能及，定当效劳。”
北寒风从怀中取出那枚代表内门弟子身份的玉牌，递了过去：“老朽年迈体衰，行动不便，宗门允诺内门弟子可至藏经阁选取两门功法。想劳烦师弟持此玉牌，代老朽前往藏经阁，选取两门功法回来。”
陈远闻言，脸上露出为难之色：“这……北师兄，藏经阁重地，弟子身份低微，只怕……”
“规矩老朽知晓，”北寒风打断他，声音依旧平稳，“所以才叫你持我内门弟子玉牌去，至于酬劳……”
顿了顿，北寒风从手中的袋子里取出本月份例的下品练气丹。
“这颗练气丹，便算作师弟辛苦一趟的酬劳，如何？”
陈远看着北寒风手上的练气丹，两眼放光，呼吸都急促了几分。
他身为杂役弟子，每月辛苦劳作，所得资源极少，一颗下品练气丹对他而言，已是一笔不小的财富。

Time passed, and half a year passed quickly.
In the hut of Feidanyuan, Bei Hanfeng, who was sitting cross-legged, was emitting a green halo.
The spiritual energy of the top quality Qi training pill in his body was being circulated by him in the "Changchun Gong" route, week after week, and then slowly introduced into his lower Dantian.
The Qi sea in Dantian is obviously completely different from half a year ago. At this time, the Dantian Qi sea was not only larger than before, but the blue light emitted was also brighter and purer.
The fourth level of Qi training period!
This is the realm where spiritual consciousness can already be used.
Stopping the "Changchun Gong" running, Bei Hanfeng opened his eyes and slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.
"The medicine stone is so powerful!" He stroked the gourd at his waist and his heart surged.
In just eight months since I entered the path, I have already reached the fourth level of Qi training. He remembered that it was recorded in the miscellaneous compilation of "Changchun Gong" that even if one had a heavenly spiritual root, without external assistance, it would take two years of hard training to reach this state.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but squeeze the gourd tightly.
In just over two hundred days, I went from dying at the age of a hundred to regaining my vitality and reaching my current state, all thanks to this magical treasure.
"I have to postpone taking pills to practice. If anyone notices that my cultivation is progressing so fast, there will be no way to survive."
In all these years of living, Beihanfeng knows it better than anyone else.
A person whose lifespan is running out, his qi and blood are exhausted, and his meridians are atrophied and almost blocked. How terrifying and terrifying it is to reach the fourth level of Qi training in less than a year.
If discovered, according to the law of the jungle in the world of immortality, the secret of his treasure will definitely lead to death. Not to mention immortality by then, even wanting a whole corpse would be a luxury.
"It seems that we must find a secret breath-containing technique!"
Bei Hanfeng pondered for a moment, then stood up and walked to the table, picking up the jade medal of identity as an inner disciple on the table.
According to the sect's rules, each inner disciple can go to the Sutra Pavilion and choose two techniques based on his jade badge as an inner disciple.
The books in the Sutra Pavilion are as vast as a sea of ​​mist and are all-encompassing, and among them there must be the method he seeks. But I decided not to go by myself.
"Then what should we do..." Bei Hanfeng held the disciple's jade token and frowned.
At this time, his eyes fell on a cloth bag on the table - it was left behind by the handyman disciple who sent him the samples every month.
Perhaps, you can lend him a hand.
…
A few days later, in the early morning, familiar footsteps were heard outside the hospital. The gray-clothed handyman disciple who delivered the monthly report showed up at the Waste Pill Institute on time.
"Senior Brother Bei, this is your duty this month." The handyman disciple handed a new bag to Bei Hanfeng who was cleaning fallen leaves in the courtyard, with the stylized respect still on his face.
Bei Hanfeng took the bag and did not put it away as usual. Instead, he raised his cloudy eyes, looked at the young disciple in front of him, and said hoarsely: "Junior brother, what do you call me?"
The handyman disciple was stunned for a moment, as if he did not expect that this senior fellow student would take the initiative to ask, and quickly replied, "Senior Brother Hui Bei, my surname is Chen, and my name is far away."
"Junior Brother Chen," Bei Hanfeng said slowly, stroking the red gourd on his waist with his skinny fingers, "I have something to do, and I want to trouble you to go there."
A trace of doubt flashed in Chen Yuan's eyes, but he still said respectfully, "Senior brother, please tell me, if I can do my best, I will definitely help."
Bei Hanfeng took out the jade token representing the identity of the inner disciples from his arms and handed it over: "I am old and frail and have difficulty moving. The sect promised that the inner disciples can go to the Sutra Pavilion to choose two exercises. I would like to trouble my junior brother to hold this jade token and go to the Sutra Pavilion on my behalf to choose two exercises and come back."
When Chen Yuan heard this, a look of embarrassment appeared on his face: "This...Senior Brother Bei, a disciple of the important place of the Sutra Pavilion, has a low status, I'm afraid..."
"I know the rules," Bei Hanfeng interrupted, his voice still calm, "That's why I asked you to take my inner disciple's jade token. As for the reward..."
After a pause, Bei Hanfeng took out this month's low-grade Qi Training Pill from the bag in his hand.
"This Qi Training Pill is regarded as a master.How about a reward for your hard work? "
Chen Yuan looked at the Qi Training Pill in Bei Hanfeng's hand, his eyes lit up and his breathing became quickened.
As a handyman disciple, he worked hard every month and received very few resources. A low-grade Qi Training Pill was already a considerable fortune to him.
